_source: Ordinal workspace agp, profile Alyssa Boger (alyssaboger), pulled 2026-08-18. All items carry the CONVERGE label.

items.title: Post #3 — The neglected middle
items.copy: healthcare philanthropy industry built around top 50 hospital systems, conferences benchmarks consulting models case studies, smallest foundations off-the-shelf software, 4,000 community hospital foundations raising $2M-$15M, too big for templates too small for enterprise retainers, structural failure, 6,100+ hospitals AHA, rural regional faith-based, strategy built for their scale

items.title: Post #6 — What CDOs wish their board understood
items.copy: hospital chief development officers what do you wish your board understood, fundraising is a relationship business relationships don't run on a quarterly clock, report donor revenue like sales bookings, gift that closes in March started with a coffee two years ago, average development director lasts 18 months, board governance, two clocks the quarter and the decade

items.title: Post #5 — Four rooms in your donor file
items.copy: four rooms in your donor file, sidewalk screening event memorial gift opt out, front porch $250 gala loyalty, living room volunteer bring friends trust, kitchen table co-creation major donors 10% of the file, Converge 26 Todd Hiestand create space for donors not nonprofit goals, donor journey segmentation

items.title: Post #8 — Four sentences CDOs say quietly
items.copy: most honest things in healthcare philanthropy weren't said on a stage, I rehearse looking calm before every board meeting, my team thinks the campaign is fine it's not, how close I came to leaving in March, the dashboard is green I'm not, 56% of nonprofit leaders increased fear and stress CEP, leadership anxiety naming it is part of leading through it, CDO candor burnout

items.title: Post #3 — Two kinds of hospital foundations
items.copy: in 24 months two kinds of hospital foundations, total giving climbing donor base concentrates into fragility philanthropy.org, volume-led foundation measures reach more names more appeals personalization nice-to-have, relevance-led foundation measures resonance segments by what donors care about, the drift is the decision, would your donors say you know them or only that you reach them
